_comment: Bundle budgets (bytes). A ratchet: ceilings pin today's build and may only go down. initial = entry script + modulepreloaded chunks + css from index.html. Known exception: vendor-echarts is still preloaded at first load (1.1 MB); shrinking it is tracked, growing it is a failure. Raised once, Owner-approved 2026-10-30: entry_script_bytes 2400000 -> 2405000 (+5000) for the request-loop guard (lib/guardedFetch.ts + requestLoopGuard.ts + the common.requestBlocked strings in the eager locales), a safety backstop that must load with the first request; it put the entry at 2402282. Lowered 2026-10-30 after lib/mock moved out of the entry (loaded on demand by main.tsx under ?mock=1): entry 2402282 -> 2374669, ceiling 2405000 -> 2380000 and initial_total 4300000 -> 4195000 (5 KB headroom for small eager additions).
